title: Shulker Palette
description: Turn any shulker box into a block randomizer. Mark a shulker as a palette and right-click to place a random block from inside — weighted by stack count.
body:
## What is Shulker Palette?

Shulker Palette turns shulker boxes into block randomizers. Mark a shulker as a "palette" and right-clicking with it places a random block from inside instead of placing the shulker box itself.

## Features

- **Weighted random placement** — blocks are selected randomly, weighted by stack count (64 stone vs 1 oak plank = stone 64x more likely)
- **Toggle per shulker** — mark individual shulker boxes as palettes via a toggle button
- **3D open-lid rendering** — palette shulkers render with an open lid showing representative items inside
- **Works on placed shulkers** — toggle palette mode on shulker boxes placed in the world
- **Peek integration** — toggle palette mode from the inventory peek view (requires Inventory Plus)
- **Survival friendly** — items are consumed from inside the shulker as you place them

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API
- [MenuKit](https://modrinth.com/mod/menukit) (required)
- [Inventory Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-plus) (optional — enables peek toggle)
